ladder.next: Either wait for the weekly to turn, or size half until it does.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; 3-day crossed down (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 28).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): bottoming. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)

entry.text: The daily turn is already in — a low formed ~3 day(s) ago @ 98.61 and price is back above the 10-day average. What's missing is the weekly timeframe confirming, so this is a partial-conviction entry available now, not a pending trigger: take a half position here, or wait for the weekly to turn.
entry.text_zh: 日线转向已经完成——低点于约 3 天前形成 @ 98.61，且价格已重新站上 10 日均线。尚缺的是周线周期的确认，因此这是当下可用的部分信心入场，而非待触发信号：可在此建半仓，或等待周线转向。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 28 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: approaching the window where lows usually form
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 28 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 接近低点通常形成的时间窗口
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (heads-up): StochRSI popped out of oversold. These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 新的周期低点可能已在 3 天前形成 （2026-06-10 @ 98.61）：摆动低点已现，价格重新站上 10 日均线——但周线周期尚未转向，因此信心仅为部分。
ladder.next_zh: 可等待周线转向，或在其转向前先建半仓。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：筑底中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）

ladder.early_note_zh: ⚡ 反转正在提前酝酿（heads-up）：StochRSI popped out of oversold。这些信号会在完全确认之前预判低点——入场更早，但误报率更高，因此应视为密切关注的提示，而非触发信号。
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.macro_line: Macro-risk headwind: aggregate macro risk is elevated and this is a macro-sensitive (cyclical) name — buy setups here have historically taken deeper drawdowns, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. A risk/sizing caution, not a forecast.
ladder.macro_line_zh: 宏观风险逆风：总体宏观风险偏高，且该标的对宏观较敏感（周期性）——在此环境下买入形态历史上回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是风险/仓位提示，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ BOTTOMING signal just triggered today (fresh cross from UPTREND). Signal strength: moderate (score +50/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 筑底中信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自上涨趋势翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +50/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: strong buy setting up (+61)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强买入构筑中（+61）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
